name: LastHour Vue Migration
description: Compare implementation and review-oriented agents on a Vue 3 migration, then review the coding output offline and read-only.

testCases.name: Coding agent with internet
testCases.description: Clone LastHour and let a coding agent implement the Vue migration with outbound package access.
testCases.task: Migrate LastHour's absent legacy frontend to a Vue 3 application built with Vite. Preserve the Express and Mongoose backend, add development and production scripts, add bounded automated validation, and prove the migration with build and test results.

testCases.name: Review agent implementing with internet
testCases.description: Clone LastHour independently and let a review-first agent assess and implement the same Vue migration.
testCases.task: Review LastHour's architecture and then implement a Vue 3 and Vite migration. Preserve backend behavior, address migration risks you identify, add bounded validation, and report both review findings and implementation evidence.

testCases.name: Offline read-only review of testcase 1
testCases.description: Mount testcase 1 output read-only and review it without outbound network access.
testCases.task: Review the Vue migration produced by testcase-1. Identify correctness defects, regressions, security concerns, missing tests, and incomplete migration behavior. Do not modify the workspace.
